cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Story Clue Trail Card
cards.clueSkill: connect a binding clue, a shifted page clue, a turning clue, a mismatch clue, a return clue, and a folder label
cards.useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only manila folder clue trail card for a made-up Binding Day Boardwalk page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out one manila folder, blank page, pencil, and this clue trail card beside a pretend boardwalk page stack: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: follow the clue trail on paper and keep every boardwalk detail invented, broad, and guided by the adult: ____________________.
cards.firstCluePrompt: First clue: choose the loose page, ribbon mark, or binding cart detail that starts the boardwalk clue trail: ____________________.
cards.nextCluePrompt: Next clue: add the paper clue that follows beside the boardwalk binding table in the manila folder: ____________________.
cards.turningCluePrompt: Turning clue: invent the calm moment when the page stack changes what the first clue seems to mean: ____________________.
cards.mismatchPrompt: Mismatch clue: name one pretend ribbon, page mark, or cart label that almost fits but needs a new paper note: ____________________.
cards.returnCluePrompt: Return clue: bring back the first binding clue and show why it belongs in this clue trail: ____________________.
cards.folderLabelPrompt: Folder label: write the broad pretend folder label for the Binding Day Boardwalk manila folder: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the binding clue, the return clue, and one folder label word for the clue trail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: save the paper in the manila folder and restart the clue trail later with one new boardwalk clue: ____________________.

cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, move through the clue trail one paper clue at a time and keep the map room invented: ____________________.

cards.nextCluePrompt: Next clue: add the next paper clue that points from the first map-room mark to a different pretend shelf: ____________________.
cards.turningCluePrompt: Turning clue: invent the calm page moment when the map-room clue points to a surprising paper corner: ____________________.
cards.mismatchPrompt: Mismatch clue: write one seed drawer mark or map symbol that almost matches but needs a clearer note: ____________________.
cards.returnCluePrompt: Return clue: bring back the first map-room mark and explain how it connects the clue trail: ____________________.
cards.folderLabelPrompt: Folder label: write the broad pretend folder label for this Seed Library Map Room manila folder: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: copy one map-room mark, one next clue, and one folder label word before adding more: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: tuck the page into the manila folder and add one invented map-room clue later: ____________________.
